facts.fact: The Ministry of National Education says it launched a project with UNESCO and the EU to build an e-learning platform, which first trains a core group of inspectors in pedagogical engineering so they can in turn train teachers (counted among the ministry's 1,019,509 fonctionnaires) to produce multimedia courses.
facts.system: E-learning platform project (UNESCO/EU quality education support programme)
